protocol: contacted audit partition for the continuous SE(3) branch
reason: The continuous-action audit windows (SCARED dataset_7 keyframes and the cecum_t1_a C3VD trajectory) were evaluated three times during the action-path audit (variants: real, real_cf, real_skip). They must not be interpreted as independent confirmation or used for further architecture, loss-weight, or checkpoint selection.

development_protocol.model_selection: leave-one-case-out grouped CV over SCARED training cases dataset_1, dataset_2, dataset_3 and dataset_5; dataset_6 is the separate validation case and dataset_7 is the contacted audit case
development_protocol.evaluation: report both deterministic within-batch shuffled actions and a fixed same-sequence hard-negative bank (radius 64, 10 negatives, seed 0); pair-level and all-negative window fractions are distinct
development_protocol.gate: grouped-CV development screens macro pair_win_fraction >= 0.8, every fold >= 0.5 and macro inverse R^2 > 0.3; audit values remain descriptive after documented contacts
development_protocol.selection_rule: checkpoints and hyperparameters are chosen on grouped-CV or the case-level validation split only; documented prior audit contacts prevent interpreting retained dataset_7 values as independent confirmation

fixes: SCARED stereo rgb.mp4 cropped to a single eye (top half) so image motion corresponds to the single-camera SE(3) pose
past-only lookback encoding (8 tubelets / 16 frames): no future-frame attention in any retained latent
no 64-frame chunk boundaries: every step gets a full look-back window
window-end pose alignment (integer frame indices, no pose interpolation)
training counterfactuals use a seeded same-sequence local-negative generator
cache_v2.status: This is the retained protocol. The v1 cache and its continuous_action_real metrics are archived diagnostics and are not manuscript evidence.
